sources.title: Getting started — Unpeel Docs
sources.finding: Free Apple-Silicon Mac client bundles server. Projects can be any folder; provider CLI accounts are separate.

sources.title: How Unpeel runs — Unpeel Docs
sources.finding: Rust Host owns detached PTY sessions and clients only attach; server/worker restarts can preserve sessions, but machine reboot cannot.

sources.title: Supported agents — Unpeel Docs
sources.finding: Named CLI runtime launch, hooks, transcript and resume support differ; Pi uses output heuristics and MCP support is provider-specific.

sources.title: Agent runtimes — Unpeel Docs
sources.finding: Managed launches bind provider conversation identity; merely observing a CLI in a blank terminal does not grant safe resume or transcript access.

sources.title: CLI reference — Unpeel Docs
sources.finding: Product CLI creates, inspects, sends, waits and controls sessions; serve install configures a per-user launchd/systemd service.

sources.title: Headless Host — Unpeel Docs
sources.finding: Same server runs on an owned Mac/Linux host with service-manager setup and phone/Mac clients; full cloud-machine matrix remains under validation.

sources.title: Workspaces — Unpeel Docs
sources.finding: Local, SSH and paired workspaces retain sessions/data on the owning host; additional local workspaces are experimental.

sources.title: Git worktrees — Unpeel Docs
sources.finding: Optional worktrees are off by default and create child projects; agent worktree preparation requires an additional grant.

sources.title: Unpeel Link — Unpeel Docs
sources.finding: Link is optional operated encrypted relay and push; service does not store session content and host must remain reachable.

sources.title: Overview — Unpeel Docs
sources.finding: One session-scoped MCP server provides browser, peer sessions, runtimes, workspace setup and artifacts; grants control visibility and use.

sources.title: Sessions — Unpeel Docs
sources.finding: Docs describe peer reads and directional write approval, but say agents cannot create/close sessions; this conflicts with newer 0.7.5 release notes.

sources.title: Agents — Unpeel Docs
sources.finding: Recognized runtime occurrences can be listed, read and waited on; stale occurrence references are rejected.

sources.title: Session gallery — Unpeel Docs
sources.finding: Session gallery shows browser captures/downloads and user images; phone markup/attachment and Host-dependent write parity are documented. Video is not supported yet.

sources.title: Sessions & terminals — Unpeel Docs
sources.finding: Provider conversation resume differs from PTY survival; precise IDs or provider-specific fallbacks are used, and ambiguous process ownership refuses replacement.

sources.title: Activity & the menu bar — Unpeel Docs
sources.finding: Busy/done/needs-you states use provider hooks or output heuristics with explicit limits; status survives app restart.

sources.title: Overview — Unpeel Docs
sources.finding: Standalone terminal plugins can be surfaced as sessions/companions; widget rail is roadmap work, not current UI.

sources.title: Projects & presets — Unpeel Docs
sources.finding: Users manage launch presets and project folders; arbitrary commands remain supported.

sources.title: Terms of service — Unpeel
sources.finding: Mac application is free without trial/account/license; Link is $59 per Host seat yearly. Terms prohibit redistribution of modified app builds.

sources.title: Privacy policy — Unpeel
sources.finding: No behavioral analytics; anonymous update records persist. Terminal UI can disable update checks with UNPEEL_NO_UPDATE. Relay cannot decrypt content; push carries bounded metadata.

sources.title: Changelog — Unpeel
sources.finding: 0.7.5 removes archive/restore and old stopped scrollback, adds session-scoped Read/Write/Create & remove grants and OSC status reporting.

sources.title: unpeel-usage README (pinned Unpeel repository)
sources.locator: Intro; provider list example; quota readings paragraph
sources.finding: Optional standalone unpeel-usage Plugin reuses local CLI logins to show provider usage: Claude 5-hour/7-day and Grok/Codex weekly allowance percentages used, plus local token totals and per-project tokens. It is not per-task billing.

sources.title: Unpeel Antigravity support at v0.7.6
sources.finding: Unpeel v0.7.6 includes a built-in Antigravity runtime, agy launch preset, native resume capability and MCP configuration.

sources.title: Unpeel native CLI platform restrictions
sources.locator: scripts/install.sh platform switch; README clients; docs How Unpeel runs
sources.finding: The native CLI installer supports macOS and Linux and explicitly rejects other OSes. The shipped clients are Mac, iPhone/iPad and CLI; the web app is explicitly later, with no native Android build. CLI access is separate from a Linux GUI.

sources.title: Unpeel PTY session execution and persistent model
sources.locator: session_host.rs launch/process/timer paths; state.rs project/preset/session data; CLI command inventory and crates/apps catalog searched for issue, backlog, container, VM, schedule and PR operations
sources.finding: The core launches detached PTYs as the Host OS user and stores sessions/projects/presets, with optional Git worktrees. It has no per-agent container/VM provisioning or separate native issue entity. Host timer jobs are runtime observation/heartbeats, not an agent-work scheduler. The CLI explicitly supports script/CI/cron session control.

sources.title: Unpeel released MCP delegation role
sources.locator: mcp_host.rs SESSIONS_ACTIONS, AGENTS_ACTIONS and tool_create_session; state.rs McpRole Manage; changelog 0.7.5 Create & remove
sources.finding: The pinned core exposes create_session, list/inspect peers, read_screen/read_output/read_transcript, waits and send_text/send_keys. A session granted Create & remove, represented by McpRole::Manage, can create workers and communicate with them. Release 0.7.5 introduced this access; the older docs prohibition on agent-created sessions is stale for this implementation.

sources.title: Unpeel optional Git review App
sources.locator: Git App README Changes and History; diffs/src/ui.rs; core/apps_mcp.rs default catalog; scripts/apps-link.sh
sources.finding: The first-party Git App, install slug diffs and binary unpeel-diffs, is registered in the App catalog. It displays staged/unstaged/conflicted/untracked changes and unified code patches, plus commit-history patches, using the same terminal/native App Kit renderer. It supports fetch/pull/push but no pull-request create/manage operation.

sources.title: Unpeel documented CI/cron command surface
sources.locator: cli.rs module documentation and new/send/wait verb implementations
sources.finding: The public headless command surface explicitly supports agents, CI and cron driving sessions without a UI or desktop app. The new command creates a preset session programmatically and send/wait manage its work. Scheduling/event ownership stays with external cron or CI.

sources.title: Unpeel human access versus agent grants
sources.locator: state.rs McpRole and workspace data; pairing/serve authorization; CLI/App inventory searched for organization roles, SAML, OIDC and SSO
sources.finding: Human access is paired-client Host access. Read/Write/Create & remove controls apply to agent sessions, not named organization/project human roles. The scoped open-source core has no enterprise SAML/OIDC SSO flow; operated Link account/relay internals are separate.

sources.title: Unpeel provider-owned account and API-key setup
sources.locator: Requirements; provider accounts and API keys
sources.finding: Unpeel launches and manages installed coding-agent CLIs but does not replace their accounts or API keys. The user supplies those credentials and pays the separate agent/provider billing.
